rows.what_the_ink_shows: The cycle expression at the upper right ends in C^{n'-n}(A): the capital A is immediately followed by the closing parenthesis, with no raised prime in the intervening white space (crops/14_scan081_L266_cycle_ambient.jpg). By contrast, the opening cohomology expression has a distinct short raised prime after A, inside its parentheses (crops/14_scan081_L266_class_ambient.jpg). The original LaTeX correctly distinguishes these two written forms.
rows.note: Author's omitted prime, not a transcription misreading. Written: u(A) in C^{n'-n}(A). Intended according to the correction row: u(A) in C^{n'-n}(A'), the image cycle's ambient variety; this is also consistent with the explicit A' in the opening cohomology expression. Retain the literal unprimed A and record the intended A' only in the editorial note. No change to the over-written/deleted Z or to any unrelated uncertainty.
rows.event_type: used and rechecked in this run
rows.event_outcome: Visually collated the full scan and separately enlarged contrast-raised crops of the cycle's ambient A and the cohomology class's A'. Confirmed that the cycle expression has no prime. This was visual and notation collation only; no independent mathematical proof check was performed.

main_reader_review: Compared the cycle expression with the cohomology expression: the former has an unprimed A and the latter a clear prime. Accepted b and preserved the written ambient A.
